name: human-allegory-engine
title_zh: 把人生事件转成可复用的寓言引擎
tagline_zh: 模型写小小说总是同一套：领导宣布、众人执行、底层受苦、老人落泪。它把这些列成模板清单，撞上就强制换两个维度重写。
tagline_en: Models write the same parable every time. This lists those beats as a checklist and forces two dimensions to change on collision.
why_zh: 拒绝模仿任何具体作家的文风，只把要求翻译成冷幽默、荒诞因果、留白这些可迁移技法；结尾掏磨损物件这类套路直接禁止。
why_en: Refuses named-author mimicry; translates requests into transferable craft. The worn-object ending is on the ban list, not the title.
limit_zh: 只写中文超短篇，上限 3000 字。默认只输出标题和正文，不给寓意、落点、创作说明。不把真实个人或机构写成加害者，不用地域/职业/贫困/残障做快捷笑点，不为煽情临时加死亡与重病。
limit_en: Chinese flash only, ≤3000 chars. Title + story only by default. No real persons/orgs as villains; no region/job/poverty/disability joke shortcuts; no late death for pathos.
title_en: Turn life events into reusable allegories
